sources.summary: Gently curving rooflines and an asymmetrical heart-shaped stairwell characterise this multi-generational home in Ahmedabad, designed by local practices Studio Saransh and Iksoi Studio. Named LJ House, the four-storey, 585-square-metre home was completed for a family of six on a compact urban plot, with the brief calling for an adaptable layout to accommodate changing needs.
